name: smart-invoice
description: SmartInvoice is a lightweight SaaS for small businesses and freelancers to quickly create, manage, and send professional invoices and receipts. Built with NestJS, PostgreSQL, Vue 3, and TailwindCSS.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
